name: Voidripper Helmet
description: Embrace your inner beast by equipping the Voidripper helmet. Layers of heavy armor plating provide premium protection and an unforgettable visage featuring a heavy brow and piercing turquoise eyes. Sakura Sun designers complimented this striking form with supreme function, including a state of the art sensor suite attached to the helmet's right side. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.
